name: Input
summary: A single-line text field — names, search, numbers, short free text.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-input> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens, so every field reads identically across apps. State and type are attributes; it emits composed `input` / `change` events. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: input
props.desc: Composed event on each keystroke; read e.detail.value

whenToUse.when: short single-line free text — a name, a search term, a number
one value from a known set — don't make the user type it

opinion.note: Label the field with a noun phrase; use placeholder for an example, never as the label. Show the invalid state only after the user leaves the field, and pair it with a message that says how to fix it.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
